evidence: The identifiable books are Maria Beatriz Nizza da Silva's: Ser nobre na colônia (45), Sistema de casamento (31), Cultura e sociedade no Rio de Janeiro (25), História da família (20), and the other colonial-history books. Together these identifiable titles carry 208/245 listed citation counts. Revista de História, et al and Anais are unresolved generic entries, not evidence of another author; the display name is erroneous for the books.

The listed works are variants, volumes, entries or later editions of Bluteau's Vocabulario Portuguez e Latino. The library record explicitly pairs the title-page name Raphael with the authority heading Rafael Bluteau, 1638-1734. The dictionary revised by António de Morais Silva is an explicitly credited adaptation, not evidence of a different Bluteau.

Clementina wrote Ecos da folia (20), O espelho do mundo (20), Cidadelas da ordem (4), the samba works (6), De historiadoras brasileiras e escandinavas (3), and Liberalismo e oligarquias (2), and organized Carnavais (12) and O direito à memória (3): about 70/84 listed counts. Armadilhas da sedução and Destinos das letras involve Maria Teresa Santos Cunha; Gestão cultural is Maria Helena Melo da Cunha's.

Campello wrote Estado e partidos políticos (25) and the three Processo político-partidário variants (7), totaling 32/64 listed counts. Brasil em perspectiva (5) may represent her chapter in that anthology. Os empresários e a educação (6) is Salgado de Souza's; A identidade da metrópole (3) is Maria Adélia's. This is a mixed pool near half, not securely above the brief's approximately two-thirds mostly threshold or securely a minority.

Fernanda wrote A velha arte de governar (26), Os tempos da mudança (3), and O Imperial Instituto Fluminense de Agricultura (2). Conquistadores e negociantes (4) can represent her chapter. História prescrita (4) is Maria do Carmo Martins's; Censura literária (4) is Payan Martins's; Revisitando a província (2) is Salazar Martins's. The LC share is around half of 71 counts, with Anais, et al and serial-only entries unresolved; dominance is uncertain.

José Sérgio Leite Lopes wrote Tecelagem dos conflitos (8), A vitória do futebol (4), Mudança social no Nordeste (2), and Cultura e identidade operária (2): 16/65 listed counts. The dominant legal-history titles O direito na história (15), As palavras e a lei (9), O Oráculo de Delfos (4), and Curso de história do direito (2) are José Reinaldo de Lima Lopes's, as confirmed by his publisher biography.

LC heading and current key identify different people. Maria Lucília Viveiros Araújo wrote Caminhos da riqueza (24 counts across two variants) and Contratos régios (2), about 26/55. O capitalismo tardio (50) and Capitalismo tardio e sociabilidade moderna with Fernando Novais (22 across title variants), plus Reflexões sobre a crise atual with Belluzzo (1), give João Manuel about 73/78 listed counts. Nobres e mascates na Câmara do Recife (two one-count variants) is José Antônio Gonsalves de Mello's. Thus a small real mixture remains, while João Manuel overwhelmingly dominates; the João Baptista display name is wrong for the main works.
